story: Vibhishana, Ravana's younger brother, begged him to return Sita. When Ravana threw him out of the court, he crossed over to Rama, told him Lanka's secrets, and after the war was crowned king of Lanka.
belief: He is honoured as a righteous devotee of Rama and as one of the immortals. Yet his name is also used as an insult for someone who betrays family, which shows how divided people are about him.
turns: Choosing dharma over family meant helping to kill his own brothers and nephews. He revealed how Ravana could be killed, and the saying 'ghar ka bhedi Lanka dhaye' (the insider brings down Lanka) comes from his story.
facts: He is one of the seven traditional chiranjeevis, the immortals.
In some versions he married Ravana's widow, Mandodari.
A legend links him to the Ranganatha idol at Srirangam.
